text: so that sounds more correct but the one thing i question is u said the 'rest is v8s runtime heap' but what does that mean because v8 isnt in the game data so ?
resolution: Corrected a conflation the user rightly challenged: I had quoted the bake's 490MB peak RSS as if it bore on 'game data scope', and called 113MB of it 'V8 runtime heap'. Measured bare v8cli = 14.5MB, so that label was wrong. Separated the two axes clearly: (1) GAME DATA = the 70MB game-file the shipped Zig no-V8 loader reads — zero V8 in the game — of which 56MB is foliage product bloat and ~14MB real; this is the true 'scope' number and drops to ~14MB after the foliage-as-formula fix. (2) BAKE TOOL memory = the 490MB peak, the compiler's transient working set (GL rule #2: a compiler, not a runtime; never ships), composed of ~14MB V8 engine + ~98MB loaded bake program & input map parsed to JS objects (288k painted cells + 2247 pieces) + the instance-buffer build (boxed number[] 105MB + 52MB Float32 copy) + 70MB output container. No code change — a measurement+clarification answer; V8 is not in the game and is only ~14MB of the bake tool.
